defects.finding: Initial module syntax/initialization ordering prevented mount in the first smoke run.
defects.correction: Closed the representation function and initialized the DOM helper before mount.

defects.finding: Stale E03 link appeared empty, so choosing the already-empty option did not remove the old association.
defects.correction: Explicit disabled previous-version option; choosing current role or No association now dispatches a real change.

defects.finding: Text edit invalidated the model but could leave old current-feedback controls visible until a full render.
defects.correction: Immediately hide stale current outcome, label review needed and clear visible criterion confirmations; Continue remains disabled.

defects.finding: Association ordering could count as a substantive amend without changed judgment.
defects.correction: Canonicalize gap/link ordering when comparing substantive meaning; source version alone and whitespace do not qualify as amendment.

defects.finding: Composition event property assignments did not bind browser IME provisional events, so provisional state was not marked.
defects.correction: Use explicit compositionstart/compositionend event listeners; preserve provisional draft and block recording/completion.
